definitions.envy: discontented or resentful longing aroused by another's possessions, qualities, or luck.
definitions.every: used to refer to all the individual members of a set without exception.
definitions.give: freely transfer the possession of; cause to receive or have.
definitions.invert: put upside down or in the opposite position, order, or arrangement.
definitions.nerve: a fibre or bundle of fibres in the body that transmits impulses of sensation between the brain or spinal cord and other parts of the body.
definitions.rivet: a short metal pin or bolt for holding together two metal plates, its headless end being beaten out or pressed down when in place.
definitions.thrive: (of a child, animal, or plant) grow or develop well or vigorously.
definitions.vein: any of the tubes forming part of the circulation system by which blood is conveyed from all parts of the body towards the heart.
definitions.vent: an opening that allows air, gas, or liquid to pass out of or into a confined space.
definitions.verity: a true principle or belief, especially one of fundamental importance.
definitions.vine: a climbing or trailing woody-stemmed plant related to the grapevine.
